messages:
alex.k: Customer reported intermittent 400s from /embeddings with 'dimension mismatch' only under high concurrency. started after they upgraded Go SDK to v0.12. stack: k8s, golang worker pool, using our embeddings endpoint.

maya.p: Can you paste the request body + exact error? sample logs?

alex.k: paste logs:
```
2024-04-07T14:02:11Z worker-7 ERROR embed: request failed id=rq_4f3a dim_error: 400 Bad Request - embeddings dimension mismatch: expected=1536 got=1024
2024-04-07T14:02:11Z worker-7 DEBUG payload: {"input_count":8, "dimension":1024}
```
Customer says only some requests show 1024.

sam: Does the Go code reuse a float32 slice across goroutines? common cause is accidentally reusing backing array and sending wrong length.

alex.k: here's the minimal repro they gave in Go (redacted):
```go
// pseudocode
buf := make([]float32, 0, 1536)
for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
  go func(item string) {
    buf = buf[:1536]
    // fill buf
    client.Embeddings(ctx, buf)
  }(items[i])
}
```
They said when concurrency > 12 they see the mismatch.

luis: that pattern will race and sometimes the slice capacity/len are wrong when serialized. Also note we recently changed default batch window in TS/Go SDKs which can make partial batches flush with wrong metadata if buffer mutated after scheduling.

maya.p: @alex.k can you ask for a full client runtime debug (set REDWOOD_SDK_DEBUG=1) and the raw request body that reached our API (we need the JSON the customer posted). Also need SDK version, GO version, and whether they use a pool that reuses buffers.

alex.k: they sent raw request sample and SDK trace: request body includes `embeddings:[...]` with length 1024. confirm this came from client not our router. Attaching trace ids: rq_4f3a, infra-trace=trace-77b.

sam: short-term workaround: deep-copy the buffer per request before calling client, or set EmbedBatchTimeoutMs=20 and EmbedMaxConcurrency=4 in their SDK config. Works for them.

luis: long-term fix: add defensive copy on SDK side when sending batch payloads if developer has opted-in to safety via env var REDWOOD_SAFE_EMBED_SEND=true. Also add validation client-side that throws if provided vector length != model.dim and prevent sending bogus requests.

alex.k: customer accepted workaround, but asked us to waive tokens for failed requests (they got billed). opening internal billing note SUP-3219.

infra-bot: deploy notice: rollout/eng-runtime v2024.04.09 includes "embed: validate length before send" flag (canary in us-west-2).

maya.p: please add a short repro unit test (Go) that simulates concurrent mutation and verify we either copy or error. cc @eng-runtime

sam: adding more: we saw a secondary issue — retry logic in TS SDK could merge a late retry into an in-flight batch, causing mis-tagging of dimension metadata. Recommend bumping retry jitter and separate retry queue.

alex.k: noted, filing follow-ups. closing with customer: provided patch/workaround + billing credit. will follow up when eng-runtime validates canary.

luis: thanks team :thumbsup:
